name: Static Texture
description: Always returns the same texture file. Exists so that places expecting a dynamic texture can still be given a plain one.

name: Configured Texture
description: The texture type used when no type is given. With only variables it swaps between existing texture files, with transformers it builds a new texture in memory from the base image.

fields.description: The base texture, as a full texture path including "textures/" and ".png". Can use variables.
A map of variables that can be used in the texture path.
Texture transformers applied to the base image, in the order they are listed.
Path the generated texture is registered under. Supports variables. If not specified, it is derived from the base path, the used variables and the transformers.

name: Entity Texture
description: Starts from the texture the entity is currently rendered with. For players that is their skin, including skins set by abilities or customizations. On its own it is rarely useful; it exists to run transformers on the skin, for example to paint a suit pattern onto it.

fields.description: A map of variables that can be used in the output path and transformer paths.
Texture transformers applied to the entity texture, in the order they are listed.
Path the generated texture is registered under. Supports variables. If not specified, it is derived from the entity texture path, the used variables and the transformers.

name: Eye Selection Texture
description: Draws the pixels the player picked in the eye selection screen of the customization menu onto an empty 64x64 skin-sized texture, in the given color. On a render layer with "light_emission" set to 15 this gives the player glowing eyes exactly where they chose. The eye selection screen requires the "palladium:customization/eye_selection" feature flag.

fields.description: The color the selected pixels are drawn in.

name: Chest Armor Texture
description: Uses the texture of the player's active "suit_chestplate" render layer, so an overlay like argon:female_chest always matches the worn suit. Shows the missing texture if no such layer is active.

name: Armor Or Skin Texture
description: For models on the body, like claws. Uses the worn suit's texture where an active layer from "model_layers" draws over the given region, otherwise the skin. Match the region to the model's UVs.

fields.description: The areas of the texture sheet to check, each as [u, v, width, height] in pixels (a 64x64 sheet). Should cover the pixels your model samples. Defaults to the bottom of the left arm: [[40, 48, 4, 4]].
How much of the region must be drawn (0 to 1) for the suit to count as covering it. 1 means every pixel.
The model layer names that count as a suit, like "suit_chestplate" in "palladium:player#suit_chestplate".

name: Secondary Eye Selection Texture
description: Like palladium:eye_selection, but for the pixels picked on the eye screen's "Secondary" tab, so a pack can color a second set on its own. Needs the argon:customization/secondary_eye_selection flag.

fields.description: The color the secondary pixels are drawn in.

name: Mouth Selection Texture
description: Like palladium:eye_selection, but for the pixels picked on the eye screen's "Mouth" tab. A pixel is an eye or a mouth, never both. Needs the argon:customization/mouth_selection flag.

fields.description: The color the mouth pixels are drawn in.
